```{python}
import _lib as L
import itables
itables.init_notebook_mode(all_interactive=False, connected=True)

k = L.csv("kandydaci.csv")
m5 = L.metrics("llm_5")
k.insert(2, "form_changed", (k["forma_podstawowa"] != k["forma_kandydata"]).map({True: "yes", False: ""}))
front = ["forma_podstawowa", "forma_kandydata", "form_changed", "kategoria", "typ_szumu", "pelny_termin", "pojecie", "obrazowalnosc",
         "do_przegladu", "zgodnosc_glosow", "kand_przedmiotowy", "kand_ogolny", "dlugosc", "pos",
         "freq_cel", "freq_kontrast", "n_mat_cel", "n_przedmiotow", "zipf_kwjp", "zipf_zpe"]
front = [c for c in front if c in k.columns]
k = k[front + [c for c in k.columns if c not in front]]
n = lambda v: L.fmt(int(v))
labelled = k["kategoria"] != "nieklasyfikowany"
models = (m5.get("modele") or {})
names = ", ".join(x.replace("claude-", "") for x in models.get("porownywane", []))
```

`{python} n(len(k))` rows: `{python} n(k["kand_przedmiotowy"].sum())` candidates from the biology materials and
`{python} n((~k["kand_przedmiotowy"]).sum())` general candidates that occur across the other subjects only.
`{python} n(labelled.sum())` rows were labelled by the language models (`{python} names`, with
`{python} str(models.get("rozstrzygajacy", "")).replace("claude-", "")` adjudicating); the remaining general
candidates were not sent to the models (`nieklasyfikowany`) and are in neither pool. No label has been checked by a human.

::: {.callout-note title="Two form columns"}
`forma_kandydata` is the string the statistics were computed for. `forma_podstawowa` is the same string unless the
models corrected a wrong base form (`{python} n((k["form_changed"] == "yes").sum())` rows); a correction is accepted
only if it keeps the number of words. Where a correction makes two rows name the same item (for example *odwłoka*
and *odwłok*, one lemma split by a tagging error), the row whose form needed no correction is the main one; the
others point to it in `duplikat_formy` (`{python} n(k["duplikat_formy"].notna().sum())` rows) and are left out of the
pools. `warianty` lists the strings merged into an item and `freq_cel_laczna` gives their summed frequency.
:::

Type in the boxes under the column names to filter a single column (for example `T3` under `kategoria`), click a
header to sort, and use **Columns** to show the hidden score, rank and per-model columns, including each model's
one-sentence reason.

```{python}
L.source("kandydaci.csv")
L.glossary(k.columns)
```

```{python}
hidden = [c for c in k.columns if c.startswith("rank_") or c.endswith(("_pewnosc", "_uzasadnienie"))] + [
    "lematy", "cls", "n_mat_kontrast", "n_klas_cel", "rozproszenie", "termopl_ok", "kategoria_final", "model_sedzia",
    "udzial_nazw_wlasnych", "ll_vs_kwjp", "log_ratio_kwjp", "freq_kwjp", "zipf_wordfreq", "duplikat_formy", "warianty",
    "freq_cel_laczna", "freq_kontrast_laczna", "srebrny_pojecie_ref"]
L.dt(k, order=[[list(k.columns).index("freq_cel"), "desc"]], hide=hidden, wrap=["pojecie", "pelny_termin", "warianty"])
```
